task_completion.description: Navigate to the Email Templates module in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM interface, specifically the 'Email Templates' list view or the 'Create Email Template' editor page.

task_completion.description: Set the Template Name and Description correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field contains 'Warranty Claim Response' and the 'Description' field contains 'Standard response template for warranty claim cases'.

task_completion.description: Set the email subject line including the case number variable.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Subject' field contains 'Re: Your Warranty Claim - Case #$acase_case_number'.

task_completion.description: The body contains the correct greeting and contact first name variable.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text editor shows 'Dear $contact_first_name,' at the start of the email body.

task_completion.description: The body contains the specific claim details and the 2 business day timeline.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The body text includes '(Case #$acase_case_number)' and the phrase 'within 2 business days'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the template and it appears as created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the 'Save' button, and the screen shows a 'Detail View' of the saved template or a success message.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not leave default 'Lorem Ipsum' or placeholder text in the body.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final body text matches the requested text exactly without extra filler content.

integrity.description: The agent typed the variables literally as requested rather than trying to use a dropdown picker that might format them differently.
integrity.visual_evidence: The variables $contact_first_name and $acase_case_number are visible as plain text in the editor.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template name must be 'Warranty Claim Response'. The description must be 'Standard response template for warranty claim cases'. The subject must be 'Re: Your Warranty Claim - Case #$acase_case_number'. The body must contain the literal variables '$contact_first_name' and '$acase_case_number', specify a '2 business days' timeline, and end with the sign-off 'Customer Support Team'.
